statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-14679 (PostgreSQL stack buffer overflow in argument match writes 0x0 and 0x1 to server memory) is fixed upstream in PostgreSQL 16.15: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-14679/ lists 16.15 as the fixed release for major version 16, and the 16.15 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/16.15/, include it. Alpine's postgresql16 16.15-r0 is the upgrade to upstream 16.15 and lists CVE-2026-14679 under its secfixes: https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/859fa0795e895af033fab32094a83301f2b4d8ff/community/postgresql16/APKBUILD. The DHI postgresql16 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from that APKBUILD and the upstream source release of the same version, and the postgres server binary in every published build (16.13-r0, 16.14-r0, 16.15-r0 and 16.16-r0), on both x86_64 and aarch64, reports the matching PostgreSQL 16 release. The affected code is in the PostgreSQL server, which ships in the postgresql16 package. The earlier published builds for Alpine 3.23 (16.13-r0 and 16.14-r0) are built from earlier upstream releases, their server binaries report those older versions, and Alpine's secfixes do not list this CVE for them, so they are recorded as affected; 16.15-r0 and later carry the fix.

PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-14679, a stack buffer overflow in argument name matching, driven by the OUT parameter count, that writes 0x0 and 0x1 bytes to server memory, in 17.11. Within major version 17, releases before 17.11 are affected. https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-14679/, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/17.11/. Debian fixed it for trixie in postgresql-17 17.11-0+deb13u1 (DSA-6438-1): https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-14679. The fixed version is this owner's first rebuild of Debian's 17.11-0+deb13u1, which packages PostgreSQL 17.11 and is no longer in the repository. Every build published now carries the fix: the postgres server binary reports PostgreSQL 17.11 in the current rebuild of Debian's 17.11-0+deb13u1 and in the 17.11-1 build, and PostgreSQL 17.12 in the 17.12-0 build and in the rebuild of Debian's 17.12-0+deb13u1, on amd64 and arm64. The earlier rebuild of Debian's 17.10-0+deb13u1, no longer in the repository, packages PostgreSQL 17.10; it is affected and sorts below the fixed version.
